a. Ensuring the depth of the screw(s) used to secure any equipment to the concrete flooring/ wall, if and when necessary, shall not exceed 50mm;

c. Clearing SCDF’s fire safety requirements and obtaining HDB’s approval for installation of glass door for entrance/ exit.

cannot
be used for any purpose/ function and must be kept empty.
8. 10. The tenant is required to safe keep the flange cover & its bolts before returning the premises to HDB. For any missing item, they are required to replace with the same type & material.
11. Tenants of basement Civil Defence Shelter premises are required to provide their own sum pump.
12.
Sale of liquor (including but not limited to hard liquor and beer) is disallowed at this premises.  Any proposal to operate 24hr will also not be considered.
13.
Please note that this block is undergoing Home Improvement Programme.
14. Upon request by HDB, the bidder is required to submit their plans showing the proposed layout and renovation of the premises (e.g., pictures, illustrations, photographs, etc.).  HDB reserves the right not to award the premises if the proposal submitted is not acceptable.
15.
Any request to upgrade the electrical load during the 1st term of tenancy i.e. first three years will not be considered.
Should there be a need to upgrade our switchroom after the 1st term of tenancy, the cost of such upgrading work shall be borne by the Tenant.  Costs of electrical submain works, or electrical standard charge based on the supply required is payable by the Tenant.
16. The proposed trade is subject to HDB’s and all relevant authorities’ approval. HDB reserves the right not to award the premises if the bid submitted is deemed unacceptable.
17.
Bidders are advised to view the unit before submitting their bids.
Please refer to the "Site Viewing Information" for more information.
Viewing beyond the scheduled dates shall not be accommodated.

23. The sc/cc is subject to final confirmation and variation by the Town Council.
24. The successful bidder is required to carry out the necessary works and to obtain all relevant authorities' approvals (e.g. BCA, FSSD, URA) where necessary for the use of the premises at their own costs.  The operation of the business shall commence only after all requirements, licenses, permission and approvals from the relevant authorities have been complied with and obtained at their own costs.
